_comment: Human-reviewed tool descriptions. JSON parameter schemas are generated from the Pydantic models in support_agent/tools/.
get_order_status: Look up the status of an order. Requires the order id (format SX-000123) and the email used for the order.
create_ticket: Create a support ticket for issues that need follow-up by the support team and return the ticket id.
handoff_to_human: Transfer the conversation to a human agent with a short summary of the conversation.
